fixed_management.notes: Fee as printed on Discount's Directive 447A page ('0.2'); the page says 'המידע המוצג הוא בהתאם לדיווח שבוצע על ידי מנהלי הקרנות'. The same row prints 'שיעור התשואה הצפויה נטו (נומינלי שנתי)' 2.75 (the column's note: reported by the manager, not guaranteed, before capital-gains tax and bank fees, net of the management and trustee fees; MF-37) and the next date 'המועד הקרוב לביצוע הפעולות הבאות' 13/11/2026 16:00, renewal 'מתחדשת אוטומטית, עד למתן הודעת פדיון על ידי הלקוח'. fundRecord has no field for the expected yield or the next date (see the branch report). Leumi's 447A page lists no renewing fund. The manager's mutual-funds page (https://www.meitav.co.il/mutual_funds/, read 2026-10-26) has no fund table and prints no fund's fee; no fund page was found in the site map. Whether the figure includes the trustee fee is not stated. The series' TASE number belongs to this monthly series only; the next series gets its own number (MF-35).
